title: A Context-Aware Contrastive Learning Framework for Hateful Meme Detection and Segmentation
reasoning: The paper includes a specific category-level evaluation and manual inspection for hateful content targeting 'Religion' (shown in Table 3). It assesses the framework's ability to identify and segment memes that are discriminatory or hateful based on religious groups, which is a component of benchmarking the model's performance on religious and ethical sensitivities.
